prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / sketch-to-render. Asset: revised home dining-sideboard peninsula, ONE two-panel photographic OFF/ON design board.
Input roles: Image 1 is the NEW exact native geometry, all proposed artificial lights on. Image 2 is that SAME NEW geometry with artificial lights off. These are geometry and camera authority. Image 3 is the owner's marked old concept, a local material/realism reference and explanation of requested edit ONLY. Red/blue strokes are selection marks, not finish colours. Do not copy the old proportions from Image 3.
Owner's change: make red connecting section smaller and a little shorter, retain only the inside area needed for retrieving cupboard contents; make blue long horizontal section longer so it is the main usable dining surface. No stools/chairs this round, and no main-room redesign.
Precise new geometry, from native anchors:
- Entire continuous pale-oak U assembly stays at H880 mm, 30mm thick, no height step to sideboard working niche. Warm-white opaque cabinetry and wood niche unchanged.
- Sideboard2200 wide x800 overall deep, ceiling closure2750; ordinary two-vertical-door fridge at living/LEFT end, OUTSIDE U. Cabinet front remains aligned with fridge door face. Preserve full open niche880–1480, shallow wooden closed flap band1480–1730, four COMPLETE upper cabinet doors1730–2700, no separate unusable top boxes, no glass doors. Three lower horizontal drawers at right.
- Narrow connector begins at same end of the sideboard next to fridge, its width is350 (previous450); cabinet-face to outer dining edge projection1150 (previous1200). Preserve the narrow600mm inside clear retrieval depth: do NOT make that notch deeper or fill it with a seat/cupboard.
- The main long dining rail is now1800 long x550 deep, horizontal across the FRONT of U. Old1400 rail extended200 at EACH END, not400 only toward kitchen. There is therefore a modest200mm rounded overhang past the connector on fridge/living side, as clearly shown in native images. This is a restrained T-ended U peninsula, NOT three-sided fully closed island. Keep right-side inner access open. Long tabletop looks clearly longer than narrow connector.
- Two slim wood support legs are recessed under the inner portion of dining rail, as in native anchors, to keep outer edge usable. No solid cabinet under long dining rail. No seat, stool, dining chair, sink, cooktop, bar accessories, TV or sofa to be added.
- The same paper-shade pendant is centred over revised dining rail. Fridge, coffee-appliance proxy, wood tray and two ceramic cups remain. Do not rearrange cabinetry.
Board: two equal side-by-side photographs, LEFT “全关灯” and RIGHT “全开灯”. Both panels must have identical native geometry, camera/crop, props and SAME soft natural daylight. OFF means ALL pendant and cabinet artificial lighting OFF: no amber strip glow in niche, no glowing paper shade. ON means warm3000K niche strip and diffuse paper pendant on, realistic light pools and soft contact shadows, no orange filter or overexposure. The pendant fixture remains physically present in both.
Photographic quality: real pale low-yellow oak grain, tactile satin cabinetry, slightly reflective graphite refrigerator, real paper fibre, warm-white walls, gentle daylight falloff and natural floor shadows. Match Image 3's believable residential light and material realism rather than native model's simplified surfaces. Don't change cabinet configuration, shelf counts, U shape or proportions while improving realism. Straight verticals, natural lens; no cartoon, plastic toy, studio exploded view or axonometric plan.
Output only the two-panel comparison, no inset, no dimension arrows, no red/blue marks, no English technical identifiers, no extra text other than the small two lighting labels.
